visualReferences.note: Standard non-hazmat Joe: bald pale manufactured face, luminous eyes, dark grey-green work uniform with brown shoulder panels/cuffs/hem, collar, front zip, utility pockets. Screenshot does not fully expose boots.
Grapple reference, two pale five-fingered hands, same brown-grey uniform and bald blank face. Enemy red optic state selected consistently for the entire candidate set.

designLock: Standard Seegson Working Joe from Alien Isolation, not hazard suit/Fireteam synthetic/Samuels/Bishop. Bald smooth pallid manufactured face, blank facial expression, red hostile optical points, two arms and two legs. Dark grey-brown/olive-grey maintenance uniform with muted ochre-brown shoulder reinforcements, narrow brown cuff/hem trim, front zip, fold-down collar and utility pockets; pale bare hands; matching dark work trousers and practical dark work boots. No weapon, gloves, gas mask, hair, armor, robot plating or exposed skeleton. Boots and side silhouette are a gameplay adaptation from incomplete camera coverage, not asserted exact 1:1 reconstruction.
